title: Accessory off-street parking
previewText:
No accessory off-street parking facilities are required for any residential or commercial development, or portion thereof, within the Atlantic Avenue Subdistrict. blocks.html: The parking requirements set forth in Sections 25-31 or 36-21 shall not apply to any development for which the Commissioner of Buildings has certified that there is no way to provide the required parking spaces with access to a street in conformity with the provisions of this Section.
